queries: site.anthropic.com Claude 4 system card instruction following safety Claude 3.7 2025

sources_considered.why: Contains directly comparable jailbreak results for Claude Sonnet 3.7, Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.
Documents a successful jailbreak against a guarded Claude system during the historical interval.
Read to verify the May 22 release date; the system card provides stronger evidence than promotional claims.
Later improvements cannot establish whether improvement had occurred by June 22, 2025.

evidence_items.explanation: The public challenge found a strategy that bypassed the guarded system across its eight target questions. This supports the persistence of safety-instruction failures, but does not establish an absence of improvement.

evidence_items.locator: Section 2.7, Table 2.7.A and following paragraph, pages 17–18
evidence_items.explanation: On the same StrongREJECT evaluation, standard-mode best-attack success fell from 31.95% for Sonnet 3.7 to 6.71% for Sonnet 4 and 18.21% for Opus 4. Extended-thinking results also improved, while remaining above zero.

unresolved_gaps: These behavioral evaluations do not settle whether Claude really understands instructions.
One comparable benchmark cannot establish improvement on every safety dimension or every possible attack.
